system.description: The Lawgiver may reward good citizens with wealth or ruin the unrighteous, her player rolling (Intelligence + Bureaucracy) in a dramatic action to decide the value (from Resources 0 to 5) of a commodity or currency in the economy within which the Solar works. This dramatic action generally takes one week of directly interacting with and influencing the market, though stunts may reduce this period at the Storyteller's discretion. This roll must overcome a difficulty of ([Bureaucracy + Influence] / 2), with the Bureaucracy and Influence values derived from the highest total rating possessed by any character who opposes the Solar's market manipulations.
